name: Stillwing
description:
A moth like a stopped watch, its wings ringed with numerals. For a moment, time near it forgets to pass.

{key.summon} sends it where you aim, within {range} paces. Costs {cost} summon charge. Every resident near it stands stopped for {seconds} seconds.

text.callHint: {key.summon} · Send the Stillwing where you aim
